about: The lamp's parts as data, for a developer. Each part says where its facts come from: docs (robots/lamp/hardware/) or code (lampOS). No maker's figure is given that the repository does not hold, so a servo's torque and speed are not here yet. Where two docs differ, both are given.

joints.bus: TTL daisy chain through a Waveshare Bus Servo Adapter on USB (/dev/ttyACM0), Feetech SCS protocol
joints.reads: the body reads and writes every servo each 20 ms; body.state gives position, goal, load and temperature
joints.power: wiring.md says an external 5 V rail, not USB; power.md's rail tree has the 12 V adaptor and a 12 V to 5 V buck
joints.model: lamp.model.json: the chain, origins, axes and reach
joints.source: docs: components.md, wiring.md, power.md; code: lamp-body (bus_out.rs, 20 ms step)

camera.model: USB UVC camera: components.md names a ZV A016 V4 (78° field of view), wiring.md an IMX307

modes.source: code: lamp-camera (types.rs), the mode the lamp uses

camera.through_the_door: never: camera frames and pictures aren't readable through lamp-control (docs/control.md)

microphones.model: Jieli USB composite mic (4c4a:4155), a dual-mic ENC module
C-Media USB audio adapter, Unitek Y-247A (0d8c:0014)

microphones_note: lampOS captures at 16 kHz (crates/audio CAPTURE_RATE); audio never leaves through lamp-control

speaker.amplifier: PAM8610 v2 class-D, on the 12 V rail

light.brightness_cap: software-capped: full white on all 32 is 1.92 A and is not allowed
light.source: docs: components.md, power.md; code: lamp_msgs::Light (COLOURS, BRIGHTEST)

touch.base_strip: MPR121, 12 electrodes, I²C 0x5A: tap, swipe, hold; thresholds calibrated per unit
touch.head_pads: TTP223 × 4 positions, 2 wired per unit (detected at start): petting

buttons.reset: 6 mm tactile, header pin 37: held 5 s or more and released is a factory reset
buttons.privacy: slide switch, header pin 11: LOW mutes the microphones, turns the camera off and mutes the speaker

air.sensor: Sensirion SEN63C (optional; SEN55 or SCD41 also declared)
air.state: declared but off on the standard profile

power.input: 12 V, 5 A adaptor (LiteOn): 60 W, worked to about 42 W sustained
power.rails: 12 V to the amplifier; an MP2482 buck to 5 V (3 A) for the board, the ring and the fan; 3.3 V from the board for the touch sensors

other.ballast: optional 5 mm steel disc, about 3 kg
other.body: 3D-printed shell, CNC aluminium servo carriers, decorative CNC wood; CAD in robots/lamp/hardware/cad
